name: Stormbringer: Eye of the Tornado refunds Static and Dark Skies stacks on non-crits (#1098, #1671)
contract: Eye of the Tornado 706297 is a permanent passive (DurationIndex 21) whose Effect[0] is SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA with EffectApplyAuraName[0] = 42 SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL and EffectTriggerSpell[0] = 804044 'Add 5 Static', whose Effect[1] is 175 SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_MODIFY_AURA_STACKS with EffectMiscValue[1] = 5 on trigger spell 803102 Static, targeted at TARGET_UNIT_CASTER, so one damaging critical strike must add exactly 5 Static. Dark Skies 300593 is the same kind of passive with EffectTriggerSpell[0] = 680855; its DBC Description resolves every promised number from 680855, whose StackAmount is 5, DurationIndex 1 (10000 ms) and EffectApplyAuraName[0] = 71 SPELL_AURA_MOD_SPELL_CRIT_CHANCE_SCHOOL with EffectMiscValue[0] = 72 (SPELL_SCHOOL_MASK_NATURE 8 | SPELL_SCHOOL_MASK_ARCANE 64) and EffectBasePoints[0] 1 + EffectDieSides[0] 1 = 2 per stack, so a non-critical direct damage spell must cast 680855 on the Stormbringer, a critical strike must remove it, five stacks must add exactly 10 Nature spell crit and nothing outside school mask 72. Both spells carry DBC ProcFlags 0 and had no spell_proc row, so SpellMgr generated no SpellProcEntry and Aura::GetProcEffectMask returned 0 on every event. Shock 804020 is the probe: SpellFamilyName 22, SchoolMask 8 Nature, DmgClass 1 magic, RecoveryTime 0, CastTime 1500 ms, and it appears in neither the class-16 ResourceGainRules nor the class-16 ResourceCostRules of AscensionCustomResourceData.h, while the Call Lightning branch of stormbringer_talent_casts that would grant it Static stays closed because 500040 is never learned here - so Shock alone moves Static by zero. The Dark Skies gain is proved with spell_cast_count of 680855 rather than its stack count, because a later critical strike wipes the stacks while the cast counter is monotonic; with base crit only, six casts make an all-critical run vanishingly unlikely. spell_crit_rating 100000 is the fixture's way of forcing the critical branches.

A second critical Shock
DISCRIMINATING: the refund repeats per critical strike, 5 + 5 = 10 Static

SETUP: Fire spell crit chance before Dark Skies, a school outside mask 72

One guaranteed critical Shock, kept well inside the buff's 10000 ms duration
DISCRIMINATING: a critical strike removes the Dark Skies buff entirely
